title: The Twin Ranks Under Heavy Fire
summary: Joins two ranks into one field of fire, crossing their volleys and passing the cover between them.

title: The Hawk-Sighted Marksman's Canon
summary: Teaches the patient waiting, the high stoop and the singling of one chosen mark at the edge of the reach.

title: The River-Bend Volley Treatise
summary: Shapes volleys along the curve of a river, using bank, ford and water-glint to place fire across a bend.

title: Basin Wall of Smoke: A Defensive Canon
summary: Turns the powder smoke of the line into cover, teaching shooters to shelter and sally from behind it.

title: The Dual-Track Loader's Canon

title: The Azure Counter-Fire Treatise
summary: Teaches a Xiantian shooter to read an enemy volley, take cover, and answer the guns that fired it.
